text: PM Modi Government Launches 100-Point Administrative Scorecard | BJP | News18 UpdatesThe Modi government’s latest administrative reform, launched in February 2026, introduces a corporate-style "Administrative Scorecard" to evaluate the performance of Union Secretaries.
